more web dev

Last edited: August 24, 2026 at 10:44 PM  •  #web development  

god i love mango juice so much.

okay i’ve officially given up on capitalization on these entries.

anyways, i’ve spent a lot of time today working on my website. mostly over at my professional engineering page in preparation for job applications (one of which i submitted earlier today!). but i’ve also been browsing more of the indie web in search for inspiration. i’m planning on joining a webring sometime soon, but i for whatever reason feel the need to flesh out my website before my grand entrance into the indie web. so i’m putting a pin in that.

i’ve been checking out this site tonight, vulpecula. i love the aesthetic, but in particular i’m really digging her media log. so yeah. i’m stealing that one.

also seeing this so-called status.cafe on a lot of websites. seems like essentially a discord status but for a website, that also happens to be shared globally on the main site. me likey. me stealy.

yet another thing i’m vibing so much with from this site: i just so happened to click on the coolest link from her outgoings page: https://corru.observer/. it’s absolutely melting my brain thinking of how this dude managed to create an entire video game in a website from PURE CSS HTML AND JAVASCRIPT. and it’s literally so cool. i need to play through it later but i’m itching to add these things to my own website.

okay it’s done. it looks pretty ugly but! at least i can start adding stuff and work on cleaning up the visuals later.
